AmiConfig.description: Meter technology mix, AMI collectors and nightly collection.

ami_route_share.description: Share of meter reading routes converted to AMI.
ami_route_share.title: Ami Route Share
ami_route_share.x-impact: Routes read by AMI. AMI reads are cheapest and miss least (1.2 percent); moving routes to AMR or walkers raises read cost, missed reads, estimates and the work they create.

amr_route_share.description: Share of routes read by drive-by AMR vans (rest are walked manually).
amr_route_share.title: Amr Route Share
amr_route_share.x-impact: Routes read by drive-by AMR vans: costlier than AMI and missed more often (3 percent), with their own anomaly factor. The rest are walked.

collector_radius_m.title: Collector Radius M
collector_radius_m.x-impact: AMI collector reach: how many collectors, and how many meters go dark when one fails on the operations day.

meter_digits_electric.description: Register digits on electric meters (rollover at 10^digits).
meter_digits_electric.title: Meter Digits Electric
meter_digits_electric.x-impact: Register digits on electric meters: where registers roll over, and how far a transposed or misread digit throws a read.

meter_digits_gas.title: Meter Digits Gas
meter_digits_gas.x-impact: Register digits on gas meters: rollover and digit-error size.

meter_digits_water.title: Meter Digits Water
meter_digits_water.x-impact: Register digits on water meters: rollover and digit-error size.

poll_end_hour.title: Poll End Hour
poll_end_hour.x-impact: When the nightly AMI poll ends: the latest time stamped on AMI reads. Results do not change.

poll_start_hour.description: Nightly head-end poll window start (local time).
poll_start_hour.title: Poll Start Hour
poll_start_hour.x-impact: When the nightly AMI poll starts: the time stamped on AMI reads. Results do not change.

AmiConfig.title: Metering & AMI

AnomaliesConfig.description: Injected faults with ground truth. Rates per 1,000 meters per year.

amr_factor.description: Multiplier on every anomaly rate for AMR (drive-by) meters: an ageing ERT fleet misreads and under-registers more.
amr_factor.title: Amr Factor
amr_factor.x-impact: Multiplies every anomaly rate on AMR meters: an ageing drive-by fleet misreads and under-registers more.

consecutive_estimates.description: Runs of 2–4 estimated periods (higher on manual routes).
consecutive_estimates.title: Consecutive Estimates
consecutive_estimates.x-impact: Runs of estimated periods (more on walked routes): estimate streaks that trigger field reads and true-ups.

enabled.description: Inject anomalies into observed reads (truth is always kept separately).
enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.x-impact: Off: reads are clean apart from missed reads, so VEE flags only what usage swings and outages explain. Truth is always kept for scoring.

exchange_registration_failure.description: Meter exchanges whose new serial fails registration.
exchange_registration_failure.title: Exchange Registration Failure
exchange_registration_failure.x-impact: Meter exchanges whose new meter fails registration: zero use, blocked bills and analyst or field work.

leak.title: Leak
leak.x-impact: Water leaks after the meter: high water reads, high-bill blocks and complaints.

manual_factor.description: Multiplier on every anomaly rate for manually read meters.
manual_factor.title: Manual Factor
manual_factor.x-impact: Multiplies every anomaly rate on walked meters: more misreads and faults on manual routes.

misread.description: Reads off by one in a high digit.
misread.title: Misread
misread.x-impact: A high digit off by one: large spikes or negative use.

missing_read.title: Missing Read
missing_read.x-impact: Periods with no read document: estimates and missing-read cases.

slow_meter.title: Slow Meter
slow_meter.x-impact: Meters under-registering 10 to 40 percent: lost revenue VEE catches only through the trend test.

stuck_meter.title: Stuck Meter
stuck_meter.x-impact: Registers that stop: zero-use reads at occupied homes, field orders and exchanges, under-billing until fixed.

tamper.title: Tamper
tamper.x-impact: Bypasses that under-register 50 to 90 percent: lost revenue and investigations.

transposed_digits.title: Transposed Digits
transposed_digits.x-impact: Two digits swapped in a read: wild spikes or drops VEE should reject.

vacant_consuming.title: Vacant Consuming
vacant_consuming.x-impact: Vacant homes that still use energy: unbilled consumption cases.

AnomaliesConfig.title: Meter & read anomalies

BillingConfig.description: Bill checks, tariff versions, invoicing, payments and dunning.

arrangement_break_rate.description: At-risk payers who break a payment arrangement after a few instalments (dunning resumes); other payers pay every instalment.
arrangement_break_rate.title: Arrangement Break Rate
arrangement_break_rate.x-impact: At-risk payers who break a payment arrangement after a few instalments; dunning resumes. Acts only on arrangements you set up in the Collections worklist.

billing_queue_worked_by.description: Who works the BILLING queue (high bills, large credits, true-ups, rate-class errors): the simulated analysts and RPA, or only you. With 'you', no analyst or RPA touches a billing block, so every outsort waits in the Studio for your release, rebill or escalation.
billing_queue_worked_by.title: Billing Queue Worked By
billing_queue_worked_by.x-impact: Who works the Billing queue: analysts and RPA, or only you (cases wait for your decisions).

budget_billing_offer_rate.description: Overdue notices after which the call centre enrols the customer in budget billing (once a year per account); the plan levels later invoices.
budget_billing_offer_rate.title: Budget Billing Offer Rate
budget_billing_offer_rate.x-impact: Overdue notices after which the customer moves to budget billing: levelled later invoices.

credit_review.description: Block a bill that is a credit larger than this.
credit_review.title: Credit Review
credit_review.x-impact: Block credit bills larger than this for review: lower means more credit outsorts.

data_error_rate.description: Installations with a wrong rate class in billing master data (per 1,000 per year).
data_error_rate.title: Data Error Rate
data_error_rate.x-impact: Wrong rate classes in billing master data: mis-billed accounts, rate-class blocks and rebills.

disconnect_days.description: Days after the due date for a disconnection notice.
disconnect_days.title: Disconnect Days
disconnect_days.x-impact: Days after the due date for a disconnection notice: later notices, fewer disconnections in the year.

disconnect_notice_days.description: Days from a disconnection notice to the earliest disconnection. A disconnection also needs a person's approval (the Collections worklist).
disconnect_notice_days.title: Disconnect Notice Days
disconnect_notice_days.x-impact: Days from a disconnection notice to the earliest disconnection. Acts only on disconnections you approve: the engine never disconnects on its own.

disconnect_payment_rate.description: Disconnected customers who pay within a week of the disconnection (and are reconnected the next business day); the rest stay off until they pay.
disconnect_payment_rate.title: Disconnect Payment Rate
disconnect_payment_rate.x-impact: Disconnected customers who pay within a week and are reconnected the next business day. Acts only on disconnections you approve in the Collections worklist.

disconnect_rule_share.description: Share of disconnection notices a collections rule approves when they are issued (the disconnection follows at the earliest day); the rest wait for a person's approval. 0: every disconnection needs you.
disconnect_rule_share.title: Disconnect Rule Share
disconnect_rule_share.x-impact: Disconnection notices a collections rule approves as they are issued: the crews' disconnects and reconnects follow, disconnected meters are not read or billed until reconnected, and disconnected contacts come in. 0 (the default): every disconnection waits for you.

first_bill_limit.description: Block a bill with no expected use (vacant, new) above this total.
first_bill_limit.title: First Bill Limit
first_bill_limit.x-impact: Block first bills above this total when there is no expected use to compare with (vacant or new premises). Rare in small towns.

high_bill_min.description: …and at least this much above the expected amount.
high_bill_min.title: High Bill Min
high_bill_min.x-impact: And at least this much above expected: filters small bills out of high-bill checks.

high_bill_ratio.description: Block a bill above this multiple of its expected amount (prior-year use at current prices).
high_bill_ratio.title: High Bill Ratio
high_bill_ratio.x-impact: Block bills above this multiple of expected: lower means more billing outsorts for analysts or RPA.

late_fee_pct.description: Late payment charge on overdue amounts (per notice).
late_fee_pct.title: Late Fee Pct
late_fee_pct.x-impact: Late charge on overdue amounts at each notice: higher balances and receivables.

low_income_approval_rate.description: Referrals the agency approves with a grant.
low_income_approval_rate.title: Low Income Approval Rate
low_income_approval_rate.x-impact: Referrals approved with a grant against arrears: less owed, fewer disconnections.

low_income_grant_max.description: Largest low-income grant credited to an account's arrears.
low_income_grant_max.title: Low Income Grant Max
low_income_grant_max.x-impact: Largest low-income grant credited to an account's arrears: less owed, fewer notices.

low_income_referral_rate.description: Disconnection notices and winter moratorium holds after which the call centre refers the customer to a low-income programme (once a year per account).
low_income_referral_rate.title: Low Income Referral Rate
low_income_referral_rate.x-impact: Notices and holds after which the customer is referred to a low-income programme; dunning waits.

low_income_review_days.description: Business days the low-income agency takes to decide a referral; dunning waits meanwhile.
low_income_review_days.title: Low Income Review Days
low_income_review_days.x-impact: Business days the agency takes to decide a referral; dunning waits meanwhile.

moratorium_end.description: Last day of the winter moratorium (MM-DD); held notices go out the day after.
moratorium_end.title: Moratorium End
moratorium_end.x-impact: Last day of the winter moratorium; held notices go out the next day.

moratorium_start.description: First day of the winter moratorium (MM-DD).
moratorium_start.title: Moratorium Start
moratorium_start.x-impact: First day of the winter moratorium: an earlier start holds more autumn notices.

notice_days.description: Days after the due date for an overdue notice and late fee.
notice_days.title: Notice Days
notice_days.x-impact: Days after the due date for an overdue notice and late fee: when fees start to build.

nsf_fee.title: Nsf Fee
nsf_fee.x-impact: Fee added to an account when a payment bounces: higher balances and more overdue amounts.

outsort_auto_release_max.description: RPA may release a high-bill or large-credit outsort only up to this bill amount (either sign); a larger one waits for an analyst.
outsort_auto_release_max.title: Outsort Auto Release Max
outsort_auto_release_max.x-impact: RPA may release outsorts up to this amount; larger ones wait for an analyst.

pad_reject_rate.description: Pre-authorized debits returned for insufficient funds.
pad_reject_rate.title: Pad Reject Rate
pad_reject_rate.x-impact: Pre-authorized debits that bounce: payment-rejected cases, NSF fees and overdue balances.

print_lag_days.description: Days from invoice creation to issue.
print_lag_days.title: Print Lag Days
print_lag_days.x-impact: Days from invoice to issue: due dates and receivable carry move with it.

rate_change_date.description: Date a new tariff version takes effect (volumetric prices).
rate_change_date.title: Rate Change Date
rate_change_date.x-impact: When the new tariff version starts: bills after it prorate across the change.

rate_change_pct.description: Volumetric price change in the new tariff version.
rate_change_pct.title: Rate Change Pct
rate_change_pct.x-impact: Price change in the new tariff version: bill amounts after the date.

reminder_days.description: Days after the due date for a reminder.
reminder_days.title: Reminder Days
reminder_days.x-impact: Days after the due date for a reminder letter: when collections work starts.

trueup_max_ratio.description: Block a bill whose estimate true-up (a negative period quantity) is larger than this multiple of the period's expected use; an analyst decides it.
trueup_max_ratio.title: Trueup Max Ratio
trueup_max_ratio.x-impact: Block estimate true-ups (a negative period after an over-estimate) larger than this multiple of expected use. Rare unless estimates run high.

winter_moratorium.description: No disconnection notices for electricity and water from Nov 15 to Apr 30 (Ontario); a notice held for the winter is issued on May 1 if the bill is still unpaid.
winter_moratorium.title: Winter Moratorium
winter_moratorium.x-impact: No electric or water disconnection notices in winter; held notices go out after the end date. Shifts collections from winter to spring.

BillingConfig.title: Billing & collections

ContactConfig.description: Why customers phone, write or use the IVR, and the agents, hours and self-service that answer them. Contacts follow the year: bills, errors, rebills, dunning, payments, move-ins and move-outs, missed reads and the year's outages and gas leaks.

abandon_cx_cost.description: Customer-experience cost of a caller who hangs up.
abandon_cx_cost.title: Abandon Cx Cost
abandon_cx_cost.x-impact: Prices the customer-experience cost of each hang-up. No contact changes.

agent_cost_per_hour.description: Loaded cost of an agent hour on the phones.
agent_cost_per_hour.title: Agent Cost Per Hour
agent_cost_per_hour.x-impact: Prices the agents' open hours in the contact cost. No contact changes.

agents.description: Agents on the phones on a business day (a small utility often has one, shared with billing).
agents.title: Agents
agents.x-impact: Agents answering during opening hours. Fewer: longer waits, more hang-ups, call backs and repeat calls, and customers who give up pay later (more overdue bills); fewer disputes get through to become cases. More: shorter waits but more idle time and cost.

autopay_cancel_share.description: Share of frustrated customers on pre-authorized debit who cancel it and pay by hand from then on (later, and sometimes not at all).
autopay_cancel_share.title: Autopay Cancel Share
autopay_cancel_share.x-impact: More frustrated customers leave pre-authorized debit and pay by hand: later payments, more reminders.

back_bill.description: Back bill: a rebill, or the first actual bill after estimates, that catches up on under-billed use.
back_bill.x-impact: Contacts about catch-up bills: rebills, and the first actual bill after a run of estimates (no-access and missed reads drive them).

balance.description: What's my balance: around due dates; mostly the IVR.
balance.x-impact: Balance enquiries around due dates; the IVR answers most.

bill_question.description: Questions about a bill: any invoice, more for estimated bills, first bills and bills after a rate change.
bill_question.x-impact: Questions about bills: more with estimated bills, first bills after a move-in and bills just after a rate change.

bill_wrong.description: Bill wrong: a bill that overcharges the customer (customers rarely call about undercharges).
bill_wrong.x-impact: Disputes over bills that overcharge against the truth: VEE misses, rate-class errors and misreads drive them. Answered, they open Bill Correction cases (rebills on a check read, dunning paused).

callback.description: Offer a call back instead of holding when the wait is long.
callback.title: Callback
callback.x-impact: Offer a call back instead of holding when the wait is long: fewer hang-ups, the same agent time spread later in the day.

callback_after_s.description: Offer the call back when the expected wait exceeds this.
callback_after_s.title: Call back after
callback_after_s.x-impact: Expected wait at which the call back is offered: lower offers it more often, turning hang-ups into later calls.

callback_take_share.description: Callers offered a call back who take it.
callback_take_share.title: Callback Take Share
callback_take_share.x-impact: Callers who accept the call back offer.

close_hour.title: Close Hour
close_hour.x-impact: When the lines close. Earlier closing squeezes contacts into fewer hours; callers who find the lines closed try again the next day.

complaint.description: Complaint: after a second unresolved contact about the same thing, or after giving up on hold twice.
complaint.x-impact: Complaints after a second unresolved contact or giving up on hold twice: long waits and low first-contact resolution drive them.

complaint_cases.description: A complaint the lines take opens a Customer Complaints case for the analysts to answer (one open complaint per account).
complaint_cases.title: Complaint Cases
complaint_cases.x-impact: Complaints become cases on the billing analysts' queue: less time for other billing work.

disconnection.description: Disconnected: customers asking to be reconnected after a disconnection you approved.
disconnection.x-impact: Reconnection requests after disconnections you approve.

dispute_cases.description: Share of answered bill-wrong contacts (and unresolved high-bill and back-bill ones) that open a Bill Correction case: an analyst checks the read and rebills, or explains the bill. 0: disputes are only counted.
dispute_cases.title: Dispute Cases
dispute_cases.x-impact: Bill disputes become Bill Correction cases: wrong bills are rebilled on a check read (a credit on the next invoice), dunning pauses while they wait.

dispute_hold_days.description: Collections pauses dunning on a disputed account until the dispute is decided, at most this long.
dispute_hold_days.title: Dispute Hold Days
dispute_hold_days.x-impact: How long a dispute can pause dunning: longer holds, fewer notices while the billing queue is behind.

emergency_answer_s.description: Answer time on the emergency line (gas odour, outages after hours).
emergency_answer_s.title: Emergency answer
emergency_answer_s.x-impact: Answer time on the emergency line (gas odours, after-hours outages).

frustration_threshold.description: Bad experiences (a hang-up after a long wait, an unresolved contact, a wait past long_wait_s, a complaint) before a customer pays later from then on. 0: never.
frustration_threshold.title: Frustration Threshold
frustration_threshold.x-impact: Lower: more customers pay later after bad service (more overdue bills, notices and disconnections); 0 switches it off.

gas_odour.description: I smell gas: neighbours of a gas leak (the household with a service leak calls 9 times in 10); emergency line.
gas_odour.x-impact: Gas odour calls from neighbours of the year's gas leaks, on the emergency line.

handle_factor.title: Handle Factor
handle_factor.x-impact: Multiplies every handling time: slower handling fills the agents' day, so waits and hang-ups rise, and frustrated customers pay later.

high_bill.description: High bill: an invoice at least 1.5 times what the account usually pays (and $40 more).
high_bill.x-impact: High-bill contacts: invoices at 1.5 times the expected amount. More estimates, leaks, cold months and rate changes raise them.

long_wait_s.description: A wait this long counts as a bad experience even when the call is answered.
long_wait_s.title: Long Wait S
long_wait_s.x-impact: Shorter: more answered calls count as bad experiences, so more customers pay later.

meter_access.description: Meter access: after a no-access read card, and to book field visits.
meter_access.x-impact: Contacts after no-access read cards and to book field visits: walked routes and no-access rates drive them.

move_in.description: Start service: a new account at a premise, days before the move-in.
move_in.x-impact: Start-service contacts before each move-in: rentals and turnover drive them.

move_out.description: Stop service: days before an account closes.

new_connection.description: New connection: builders and owners asking for a new service.

open_hour.title: Open Hour
open_hour.x-impact: When the lines open on business days. Later opening squeezes the same contacts into fewer hours: longer waits at peaks.

outage.description: Outage report: customers who lose power or water (twice as many when it lasts over two hours); the IVR's outage message answers most.
outage.x-impact: Outage reports from customers who lose power or water in the year's incidents; the IVR's outage message answers most, after hours the emergency line.

password.description: Forgot password or online account help: when bills arrive; most reset online.
password.x-impact: Online account help when bills arrive; most reset online.

patience_s.description: Average time a caller waits before hanging up.
patience_s.title: Patience
patience_s.x-impact: How long callers hold before hanging up. Less patience: more hang-ups and retries at the same waits, and more customers who pay later after bad service.

payment_arrangement.description: Can't pay: after overdue notices, more after disconnection notices.
payment_arrangement.x-impact: Can't-pay contacts after reminders, overdue notices and disconnection notices: collections settings and payer mix drive them.

payment_problem.description: Payment problem: a pre-authorized debit returned.
payment_problem.x-impact: Contacts after a returned pre-authorized debit (the PAD reject rate drives them).

repeat_share.description: Callers whose problem was not resolved who contact again within days.
repeat_share.title: Repeat Share
repeat_share.x-impact: Customers whose problem was not resolved who contact again: repeat contacts, and complaints after a second failure.

retry_share.description: Callers who hung up or found the lines closed and try again.
retry_share.title: Retry Share
retry_share.x-impact: Callers who hung up or found the lines closed and try again: retries add load at busy times; the rest give up unanswered.

self_serve_cost.description: Cost of a contact the IVR or website handles.
self_serve_cost.title: Self Serve Cost
self_serve_cost.x-impact: Prices each self-served contact. No contact changes.

self_serve_factor.description: Multiplies every reason's self-service share (0: IVR and web down).
self_serve_factor.title: Self Serve Factor
self_serve_factor.x-impact: Multiplies the share the IVR and website handle; zero sends every contact to an agent.

service_target_s.description: Answer target for the service level (answered within it).
service_target_s.title: Service target
service_target_s.x-impact: The answer target the service level counts against. It changes the reported service level, not who waits.

volume_factor.title: Volume Factor
volume_factor.x-impact: Multiplies every reason's rates: a quick way to test a busier or quieter year.

ContactConfig.title: Contact centre

ContactReason.description: One reason customers contact the utility: how often it happens and what handling it takes.

handle_min.description: Agent minutes per contact (talk and wrap-up).
handle_min.title: Handle Min

per_1000.description: Background contacts per 1,000 accounts per month.
per_1000.title: Per 1000

per_event.description: Share of triggering events that lead to a contact.
per_event.title: Per Event

resolved.description: Share resolved on the first contact.
resolved.title: Resolved

self_serve.description: Share handled by the IVR or online, with no agent.
self_serve.title: Self Serve

ContactReason.title: ContactReason

CustomersBillingConfig.description: Accounts, reading routes, calendars and tariffs.

bill_cycles.description: Billing portions per month (one per working day).
bill_cycles.title: Bill Cycles
bill_cycles.x-impact: Billing portions per month: how reads and bills spread across working days, so daily queue load and when bills go out.

currency.title: Currency
currency.x-impact: The currency label on bills. Amounts do not change.

due_days.description: Days from invoice to due date.
due_days.title: Due Days
due_days.x-impact: Days from invoice to due date: when accounts go overdue, so receivable carry and the dunning calendar.

electric_blocks.description: Electric energy price blocks per kWh (summer threshold).
electric_blocks.title: Electric Blocks
electric_blocks.x-impact: Energy price blocks: bill amounts, high-bill checks and the cost of each billing error.

electric_fixed_monthly.description: Electric fixed delivery charge per month.
electric_fixed_monthly.title: Electric Fixed Monthly
electric_fixed_monthly.x-impact: Fixed electric charge: every electric bill moves by this, whatever the usage.

electric_variable_delivery.title: Electric Variable Delivery
electric_variable_delivery.x-impact: Delivery charge per kWh: electric bills scale with usage.

gas_fixed_monthly.title: Gas Fixed Monthly
gas_fixed_monthly.x-impact: Fixed gas charge: every gas bill moves by this, whatever the usage.

gas_price_m3.title: Gas Price M3
gas_price_m3.x-impact: Gas price per m³: winter gas bills scale with it.

late_payer_share.title: Late Payer Share
late_payer_share.x-impact: Accounts that pay late; the rest are at-risk payers who may not pay at all. More late and at-risk payers drive dunning and disconnections.

mru_target_meters.description: Target premises per meter reading unit (route).
mru_target_meters.title: Mru Target Meters
mru_target_meters.x-impact: Premises per reading route. Every town gets at least one route per billing portion (21), so it only bites above about 9,500 premises; then smaller routes mean more of them and a different split of AMI, AMR and walked routes.

net_metering_credit.title: Net Metering Credit
net_metering_credit.x-impact: Credit per exported kWh: solar homes' summer bills and the large-credit checks.

on_time_payer_share.description: Share of accounts that pay on time.
on_time_payer_share.title: On Time Payer Share
on_time_payer_share.x-impact: Accounts that pay on time. Fewer means more overdue balances, reminders, notices, late fees and collections work.

pre_authorized_share.title: Pre Authorized Share
pre_authorized_share.x-impact: Accounts on pre-authorized debit: they pay on the due date, but a share bounce, which opens payment-rejected cases and NSF fees.

tax_rate.description: Sales tax on utility bills (Ontario HST).
tax_rate.title: Tax Rate
tax_rate.x-impact: Sales tax on every bill: invoice totals, receivables and late fees scale with it.

wastewater_ratio.description: Wastewater charge as a multiple of the water volumetric charge.
wastewater_ratio.title: Wastewater Ratio
wastewater_ratio.x-impact: Wastewater as a multiple of the water price: water bills scale with it.

water_fixed_monthly.title: Water Fixed Monthly
water_fixed_monthly.x-impact: Fixed water charge: every water bill moves by this, whatever the usage.

water_price_m3.title: Water Price M3
water_price_m3.x-impact: Water price per m³: water bills scale with it, and wastewater follows it.

CustomersBillingConfig.title: Customers & billing

ElectricConfig.description: Bulk supply, substations, feeders, transformers, services.

coincidence_floor.description: Coincidence factor CF(n) = a + (1-a)/√n; a is the floor as n → ∞.
coincidence_floor.title: Coincidence Floor
coincidence_floor.x-impact: How much peaks overlap: larger floors size bigger transformers and feeders.

conductor_planning_margin.description: Primary conductors are sized for design load × this margin (winter peaks, load growth).
conductor_planning_margin.title: Conductor Planning Margin
conductor_planning_margin.x-impact: Head-room in primary conductor sizing: thicker conductors, less loading on the map.

feeder_design_mva.title: Feeder Design Mva
feeder_design_mva.x-impact: Design peak per feeder: how many feeders, and so how many customers one feeder fault interrupts.

feeder_max_customers.description: Most customers planned on one feeder (limits how many lose supply when a feeder breaker trips).
feeder_max_customers.title: Feeder Max Customers
feeder_max_customers.x-impact: Most customers on one feeder: the largest outage one breaker trip can cause.

kva_ac.description: Added peak for central air conditioning.
kva_ac.title: Kva Ac
kva_ac.x-impact: Design load added for air conditioning: equipment sizing on the map.

kva_electric_heat.description: Added peak for electric resistance heat.
kva_electric_heat.title: Kva Electric Heat
kva_electric_heat.x-impact: Design load added for electric heat: equipment sizing on the map.

kva_ev.description: Added peak for a Level-2 EV charger.
kva_ev.title: Kva Ev
kva_ev.x-impact: Design load added for an EV charger: equipment sizing on the map.

kva_heat_pump.description: Added peak for a heat pump.
kva_heat_pump.title: Kva Heat Pump
kva_heat_pump.x-impact: Design load added for a heat pump: equipment sizing on the map.

kva_per_100m2.description: Individual peak demand per 100 m² of floor area (lighting, plug, appliances).
kva_per_100m2.title: Kva Per 100M2
kva_per_100m2.x-impact: Design load per floor area: transformer and conductor sizes, so loading and overload failures on the operations day. Usage is not affected.

kva_pool.description: Added peak for a pool pump/heater.
kva_pool.title: Kva Pool
kva_pool.x-impact: Design load added for a pool: equipment sizing on the map.

max_houses_per_transformer_overhead.description: Max houses on a pole-mount transformer.
max_houses_per_transformer_overhead.title: Max Houses Per Transformer Overhead
max_houses_per_transformer_overhead.x-impact: Houses per pole transformer: how many customers lose power when one fails.

max_houses_per_transformer_underground.description: Max houses on a pad-mount transformer.
max_houses_per_transformer_underground.title: Max Houses Per Transformer Underground
max_houses_per_transformer_underground.x-impact: Houses per pad transformer: how many customers lose power when one fails.

min_feeders_per_substation.description: Feeders leaving each substation at least (fewer only when it serves fewer transformer groups), so normally-open ties can back-feed.
min_feeders_per_substation.title: Min Feeders Per Substation
min_feeders_per_substation.x-impact: Feeders per substation, so ties can back-feed during an outage.

overhead_before_year.description: Districts built before this year are overhead (poles); later underground.
overhead_before_year.title: Overhead Before Year
overhead_before_year.x-impact: Districts built before this year are on poles: storm faults and pole transformers on the operations day.

pole_spacing_m.title: Pole Spacing M
pole_spacing_m.x-impact: Pole span on overhead lines: pole count, and where AMI collectors can mount.

primary_kv.description: Primary distribution line-to-line voltage (Ontario urban 13.8 kV; US 12.47 kV).
primary_kv.title: Primary Kv
primary_kv.x-impact: Feeder voltage: voltage drop and loading in the operations day's power flow.

route_corridor_change_penalty_m.description: Routing cost of switching from one arterial/collector corridor to another.
route_corridor_change_penalty_m.title: Route Corridor Change Penalty M
route_corridor_change_penalty_m.x-impact: How much feeders avoid switching corridors: straighter feeders on the map.

route_hierarchy_penalty_m.description: Routing cost per step up or down the road hierarchy (arterial ↔ collector ↔ local).
route_hierarchy_penalty_m.title: Route Hierarchy Penalty M
route_hierarchy_penalty_m.x-impact: How much feeders avoid stepping between road classes.

route_shared_trunk_factor.description: Cost multiplier for running a feeder express through another feeder's territory or alongside its trunk.
route_shared_trunk_factor.title: Route Shared Trunk Factor
route_shared_trunk_factor.x-impact: How much feeders avoid running through each other's territory.

route_turn_penalty_m.description: Routing cost of a 90° turn, in weighted metres; it grows with the square of the angle (a U-turn costs 4×). Bends under 10° are free.
route_turn_penalty_m.title: Route Turn Penalty M
route_turn_penalty_m.x-impact: How much feeders avoid turns: straighter, longer trunks.

route_weight_arterial.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along an arterial (trunks follow the cheapest corridors).
route_weight_arterial.title: Route Weight Arterial
route_weight_arterial.x-impact: Feeder routing cost along arterials: where trunks run and which customers share them.

route_weight_collector.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along a collector.
route_weight_collector.title: Route Weight Collector
route_weight_collector.x-impact: Feeder routing cost along collector roads: where trunks run on the map.

route_weight_local.description: Feeder routing cost per metre along a local street.
route_weight_local.title: Route Weight Local
route_weight_local.x-impact: Feeder routing cost along local streets: where trunks run on the map.

secondary_v.title: Secondary V
secondary_v.x-impact: Service voltage for the power flow and the voltage readings on the map.

section_max_share.description: Sectionalising switches cut each feeder's three-phase backbone into sections of at most this share of the feeder's customers (at least section_min_customers), so a crew isolates a fault within a bounded section and ties back-feed the healthy sections beyond it.
section_max_share.title: Section Max Share
section_max_share.x-impact: Sectionalising switches: smaller sections mean a fault takes out fewer customers.

section_min_customers.description: Smallest section limit: a feeder is not cut into sections smaller than this many customers.
section_min_customers.title: Section Min Customers
section_min_customers.x-impact: Smallest section a feeder is cut into: how few customers one fault can take out.

substation_mva.title: Substation Mva
substation_mva.x-impact: Firm capacity per substation: big towns get a second substation.

tie_max_length_m.description: Longest new line built for a tie: to a feeder that touches no other feeder, or from a switched section to another feeder's three-phase line (or round to its own feeder's). Along a street a line already uses, a metre counts 1.25 (single-phase) or 2 (three-phase).
tie_max_length_m.title: Tie Max Length M
tie_max_length_m.x-impact: Longest line built for a tie: more ties, more restoration options.

ties_per_feeder_pair.description: Normally-open tie switches between each pair of neighbouring feeders (0: no ties at all, section ties included).
ties_per_feeder_pair.title: Ties Per Feeder Pair
ties_per_feeder_pair.x-impact: Normally-open ties: with ties, crews restore part of a faulted feeder from a neighbour, so outages are shorter on the operations day.

transformer_kva_steps.title: Transformer Kva Steps
transformer_kva_steps.x-impact: The transformer sizes available: groupings, loading and overloads on the map.

transformer_max_loading.description: Allowed peak loading relative to nameplate.
transformer_max_loading.title: Transformer Max Loading
transformer_max_loading.x-impact: Allowed loading before a bigger transformer is chosen: overloaded units fail three times as often on the operations day.

trunk_min_load_share.description: A feeder trunk extends along a corridor while at least this share of the feeder's connected load lies at or beyond that point; smaller tails are served by laterals.
trunk_min_load_share.title: Trunk Min Load Share
trunk_min_load_share.x-impact: How far a three-phase trunk extends before laterals take over.

voltage_max_pu.description: Upper service voltage limit (premises.voltageLimits in frames).
voltage_max_pu.title: Voltage Max Pu
voltage_max_pu.x-impact: High-voltage limit for the voltage readings on the map.

voltage_min_pu.description: Lower service voltage limit (CSA CAN3-C235 / ANSI Range A). Frames report it on a 120 V base (premises.voltageLimits) with the premises below it; less 4 V it is the default floor for back-feeding through a tie.
voltage_min_pu.title: Voltage Min Pu
voltage_min_pu.x-impact: Low-voltage limit for the voltage readings on the map.

ElectricConfig.title: Electric distribution

EraValues.description: A value per construction era: pre-1945 core, 1945–1978 post-war, post-1978 modern subdivisions.
EraValues.title: EraValues

FieldConfig.description: The work the field crews do over the year and the crews that do it: customer emergencies, service orders (disconnects, reconnects, move-ins and move-outs), meter maintenance (seal exchanges, batteries, removals), preventative maintenance on the networks and capital construction (new sets, upgrades, main renewal). Work follows the year: collections, moves, VEE field visits, the contact centre's calls, the year's outages and leaks, the meters' install years and the town's assets. What the crews do changes the year: a disconnected or removed meter is not read or billed, an exchange registers a new meter, and maintenance left overdue fails (dead batteries, drifting meters, outages, gas leaks).

ami_battery.description: Module battery replacement on gas and water meters: share of batteries reaching their life this year.
ami_battery.title: Module battery
ami_battery.x-impact: Module battery replacements due this year.

ami_conversion.description: AMI conversion: share of AMR and manually read meters converted to AMI this year (capital, priority 4).
ami_conversion.title: AMI conversion
ami_conversion.x-impact: AMR and manually read meters converted to AMI, route by route in the season: fewer missed reads and no-access visits after. Off by default.

battery_years.description: Radio module battery life on gas and water meters, AMI and AMR (they have no mains power).
battery_years.title: Battery Years
battery_years.x-impact: Module battery life: picks which install year's gas and water modules get new batteries this year.

callout_minutes.description: After hours, the time an on-call responder takes to get on the road.
callout_minutes.title: Callout Minutes
callout_minutes.x-impact: Time for an on-call responder to get on the road after hours: emergency response times at night and on weekends.

construction_end_month.description: Last month of the construction season.
construction_end_month.title: Construction End Month
construction_end_month.x-impact: Last month of the construction season: work not built by then waits for next year.

construction_start_month.description: First month of the construction season (digging is frost-free).
construction_start_month.title: Construction Start Month
construction_start_month.x-impact: First month of the construction season: new services, upgrades, AMI conversion and main renewal wait for it.

corrective_exchange.description: Faulty meter exchanged on a field visit (the run decides when): share recorded.
corrective_exchange.x-impact: Faulty meters exchanged on field visits: follows the anomalies (stuck, slow, tamper) and the field visits that find them.

crew_construction.title: Construction crews
crew_construction.x-impact: Construction crews: new services and main renewal through the season.

crew_electric.description: Pole work, tree trimming, outage repairs, service upgrades.
crew_electric.title: Electric line crews
crew_electric.x-impact: Electric line crews: outage repairs take their time first, then pole and tree programmes and service upgrades.

crew_emergency.description: Gas odour and no-supply calls, any hour of any day.
crew_emergency.title: On-call responders
crew_emergency.x-impact: On-call responders: fewer stretch emergency response when emergencies overlap; the cost prices their time.

crew_gas.description: Leak surveys, regulator stations, leak repairs.
crew_gas.title: Gas crews
crew_gas.x-impact: Gas crews: leak repairs, leak surveys and regulator inspections.

crew_meter.description: Disconnects, reconnects, move visits, exchanges, batteries, removals, investigations, meter sets.
crew_meter.title: Meter technicians
crew_meter.x-impact: Meter technicians: service orders, VEE visits, exchanges, batteries and meter sets share them. Fewer: backlog, late disconnects and move reads, overtime.

crew_water.title: Water crews
crew_water.x-impact: Water crews: main break repairs, valve and hydrant programmes and their repairs.

dead_battery_miss.description: Share of reads a radio module misses once its battery has died (past its life and not replaced): estimates follow.
dead_battery_miss.title: Dead Battery Miss
dead_battery_miss.x-impact: Reads a module misses once its battery died (not replaced by its anniversary): estimates, estimation cases and contacts follow.

deferred_leak_escalation.description: Chance a year that a leak found by survey becomes a public gas leak (odour calls, an emergency) once its repair is overdue.
deferred_leak_escalation.title: Deferred Leak Escalation
deferred_leak_escalation.x-impact: How likely a surveyed leak overdue for repair becomes a public gas leak: odour calls and emergency response.

deferred_pole_failures.description: Chance a year that a pole found needing replacement fails once its replacement is overdue (ten times as likely on a storm day): an outage.
deferred_pole_failures.title: Deferred Pole Failures
deferred_pole_failures.x-impact: How likely an overdue pole replacement fails: an outage (use lost, AMI meters dark), outage reports and repairs on the line crews.

deferred_tree_faults.description: Chance on a storm day that an overhead span overdue for trimming faults: an outage.
deferred_tree_faults.title: Deferred Tree Faults
deferred_tree_faults.x-impact: How likely a span overdue for trimming faults on a storm day: an outage (use lost, AMI meters dark) and outage reports.

disconnect.description: Disconnect for non-payment: share of collections disconnections worked (AMI electric with a switch is done remotely).
disconnect.x-impact: Disconnections the crews carry out (approved in Collections). A disconnected meter is not read and not billed until it is reconnected.

failed_lot_drift.description: Under-registration of a failed seal lot's meters, from the failed test until each is exchanged.
failed_lot_drift.title: Failed Lot Drift
failed_lot_drift.x-impact: How much a failed seal lot's meters under-register until exchanged: less billed against the truth while the exchanges wait.

gas_leak_repair.description: Gas leak repair (grade 2): leaks found per surveyed km.
gas_leak_repair.x-impact: Leaks found per surveyed kilometre: grade 2 repairs on the gas crews.

gas_odour.description: Gas odour investigation: share of gas odour reports (a leak's first report, every background report) a responder attends.
gas_odour.title: Gas odour
gas_odour.x-impact: Gas odour reports a responder attends; follows the year's gas leaks and the contact centre's gas odour calls.

hydrant_flush.description: Hydrant flushing and inspection: share of hydrants a year (May to October).
hydrant_flush.title: Hydrant flushing
hydrant_flush.x-impact: Hydrants flushed May to October; flushing finds hydrants to repair.

hydrant_repair.description: Hydrant repair: share of flushed hydrants found defective.

leak_survey.description: Gas leak survey: share of gas main length walked a year (minutes per km).
leak_survey.x-impact: Gas main walked a year; surveys find leaks to repair.

main_replacement.description: Main renewal: share of cast-iron water and gas main length replaced a year (minutes and materials per 100 m).
main_replacement.title: Main renewal
main_replacement.x-impact: Cast-iron main renewed a year: the biggest capital cost.

meter_investigation.description: VEE field visit (the run decides when): share recorded against the meter technicians.
meter_investigation.x-impact: VEE field visits on the meter technicians' time: follows the process settings (field orders a day, field days) and the anomalies.

meter_set.description: Meter set on a finished new service: share set by a meter technician (the rest come with the contractor).
meter_set.x-impact: Meter sets on finished new services by the meter technicians.

move_in.description: Move-in turn-on or first read: share of account openings at a premise with a meter that cannot be read remotely.
move_in.title: Move-in read
move_in.x-impact: Move-in visits: account openings at premises without AMI (not the day after a move-out there).

move_out.description: Move-out final read or lock-off: share of account closings at a premise with a meter that cannot be read remotely.
move_out.title: Move-out read
move_out.x-impact: Move-out visits: account closings at premises without AMI.

new_set.description: New service: share of new-connection requests (the contact centre's new connection contacts) that go ahead; built in the construction season.
new_set.title: New set (new service)
new_set.x-impact: New-connection requests that go ahead: new services built in the season, then meter sets. Follows the contact centre's new connection contacts.

no_supply.description: No supply at one premise (a service fault, a blown fuse, a curb stop): share of single-premise outage reports that need a truck.
no_supply.x-impact: Single-premise no-supply reports that need a truck; follows the contact centre's outage reports.

old_water_meter_drift.description: Under-registration of water meters at or past their service life, until replaced (read at the start of the year).
old_water_meter_drift.title: Old Water Meter Drift
old_water_meter_drift.x-impact: How much water meters past their life under-register until replaced: the revenue a replacement programme recovers.

outage_repair.description: Repair of the year's outages and leaks (the incident model times it): share recorded against the utility's crew.
outage_repair.title: Outage and leak repair
outage_repair.x-impact: Outage and leak repairs on the utilities' crews, timed by the incident model; follows the outages settings.

overtime_max_hours.description: Most hours a crew works past its shift to finish same-day and overdue customer work (priority 1 and 2).
overtime_max_hours.title: Overtime Max Hours
overtime_max_hours.x-impact: Overtime per crew for customer work due today or overdue: more keeps disconnects, reconnects and move reads on time, at overtime cost.

pole_inspection.description: Pole inspection: share of poles inspected a year (0.1 is a ten-year cycle).
pole_inspection.x-impact: Poles inspected a year; inspections find poles to replace.

pole_replacement.description: Pole replacement: share of inspected poles found needing replacement.
pole_replacement.x-impact: Inspected poles found needing replacement: long, costly line crew jobs.

reconnect.description: Reconnect after payment: share of reconnections worked, due the next business day.
reconnect.x-impact: Reconnections the crews do after payment; the rest come back without a visit.

regulator_inspection.description: Regulator station inspection: share of stations (city gate, district regulators) a year.

remote_switch_share.description: Share of AMI electric meters with a remote connect switch: their disconnects, reconnects and move reads need no truck.
remote_switch_share.title: Remote Switch Share
remote_switch_share.x-impact: AMI electric meters with a remote switch: their disconnects and reconnects need no truck.

removal.description: Meter removal (vacant premise, service abandoned): removals per 1,000 premises a year.
removal.title: Meter removal
removal.x-impact: Meter removals at vacant premises: the removed meters are not read or billed again.

renewed_main_break_factor.description: A renewed main's breaks and leaks, as a share of the cast-iron main's it replaced: from the day the construction crew finishes a segment.
renewed_main_break_factor.title: Renewed Main Break Factor
renewed_main_break_factor.x-impact: How much less a renewed main breaks and leaks than the cast iron it replaced: fewer main breaks and gas leaks (outages, contacts, repairs) after the construction crews renew it.

routing.description: Crews drive the town's streets: from the depot in the morning, job to job by the fastest route (the operations driving speeds), and back at the end of the day. Of the jobs equally urgent and due, a crew takes the nearest next. On-call responders drive from the depot and back. Off, or in a town without streets: every visit adds travel_minutes.
routing.title: Routing
routing.x-impact: Crews drive the streets from the depot, job to job, nearest first: travel follows the town's size and layout. Off: a flat travel time per visit (usually more crew time, later work and slower emergency response).

seal_exchange.description: Seal-expiry exchange: share of the meters due (the sample of every expiring lot, every meter of a failed lot) exchanged. A failed lot's meters are due by 31 December.
seal_exchange.x-impact: Seal-expiry exchanges: the samples and failed lots due this year, each a new meter on the installation (reads and bills on the new register).

seal_lot_pass_rate.description: Share of lots that pass compliance sampling and are resealed; a failed lot is exchanged meter by meter before its seal expires.
seal_lot_pass_rate.title: Seal Lot Pass Rate
seal_lot_pass_rate.x-impact: Lots that pass sampling. A failed lot has every meter exchanged by 31 December: the biggest swing in meter work.

seal_sample_size.description: Meters pulled and tested from each lot whose seal expires.
seal_sample_size.title: Seal Sample Size
seal_sample_size.x-impact: Meters pulled from each expiring lot: more sample exchanges.

seal_years_electric.description: Electric meter seal period: a lot whose seal expires this year is sampled.
seal_years_electric.title: Seal Years Electric
seal_years_electric.x-impact: Electric seal period: picks which install year's lots are sampled this year (the meters' install cohorts set the volume).

seal_years_gas.title: Seal Years Gas
seal_years_gas.x-impact: Gas seal period: picks which install year's lots are sampled this year.

service_upgrade.description: Electric service upgrade: share of homes with an EV or electric heat upgrading a year.
service_upgrade.x-impact: Homes with an EV or electric heat upgrading their service a year.

shift_hours.description: Hours in a crew's working day.
shift_hours.title: Shift Hours
shift_hours.x-impact: Hours in a crew's day: every business-day crew's capacity. Shorter days build backlog, overdue work and overtime.

shift_start_hour.description: Crews start their day (local time, business days).
shift_start_hour.title: Shift Start Hour
shift_start_hour.x-impact: When the business-day crews start. It moves when work is done in the day and which emergencies fall after hours (call-out and overtime).

stop_minutes.description: With routing: parking, walking to the asset and setting up at each stop, added to the drive.
stop_minutes.title: Stop Minutes
stop_minutes.x-impact: Time at each stop on top of the drive (with routing): more fills the crews' day with fewer jobs.

travel_minutes.description: Driving to the job and back, added to every visit without routing (and to the VEE field visits the run times).
travel_minutes.title: Travel Minutes
travel_minutes.x-impact: Without routing, driving to each job and back: more travel fills the crews' day with fewer jobs, and slows emergency response. VEE field visits use it always.

tree_trimming.description: Tree trimming: share of overhead spans trimmed a year (minutes per span).

valve_exercise.description: Valve exercising: share of water and gas valves a year.
valve_exercise.x-impact: Water and gas valves exercised a year; exercising finds valves to repair.

valve_repair.description: Valve repair: share of exercised valves found broken or stuck.
valve_repair.x-impact: Exercised valves found broken: repairs on the utility's crew.

water_meter_life_years.description: Water meters this old or older are due for replacement.
water_meter_life_years.title: Water Meter Life Years
water_meter_life_years.x-impact: Water meters this old or older are due for replacement: a shorter life puts more cohorts in the backlog.

water_meter_replacement.description: Water meter replacement by age: share of over-age water meters replaced this year.
water_meter_replacement.x-impact: Over-age water meters replaced this year (new meters, no more drift); the rest keep under-registering.

FieldConfig.title: Field work

FieldCrew.description: One kind of field crew: how many there are for the town's size, and what an hour costs.

cost_per_hour.description: Loaded cost of a crew hour, truck included.
cost_per_hour.title: Cost Per Hour

overtime_factor.description: Multiplies the hourly cost after hours.
overtime_factor.title: Overtime Factor

per_1000_premises.description: Crews per 1,000 premises. A fraction is part of a crew's time (the rest goes to work this model does not draw); on-call responders are at least one when above zero.
per_1000_premises.title: Per 1000 Premises

FieldCrew.title: FieldCrew

FieldWorkType.description: One kind of field work order: how much of it there is, what it takes and how soon it is due.

minutes.description: Crew minutes on site per order (travel is added for premise visits).
minutes.title: Minutes

rate.description: How much of this work there is (its meaning is in the setting's own description).
rate.title: Rate

target_days.description: Business days from the order's release to its due date (0: the same day; planned work is released on its scheduled day). Emergencies count calendar time: fractions of a day.
target_days.title: Target Days

FieldWorkType.title: FieldWorkType

GasConfig.description: City gate, mains, regulators and services.

all_electric_district_share.description: Share of districts with no gas mains (all-electric).
all_electric_district_share.title: All Electric District Share
all_electric_district_share.x-impact: Share of districts without gas mains, counted in whole districts, the core last (1: no gas mains at all): those homes heat with electricity, mostly heat pumps. Gas accounts and usage fall, winter electric usage rises. One-district towns (under 2,251 homes: village, small_town) have none whatever the share.

base_pressure_kpa.description: Base pressure for standard volume: the Weymouth base pressure in gas main sizing and pressures (default 14.73 psia).
base_pressure_kpa.title: Base Pressure Kpa
base_pressure_kpa.x-impact: Standard-volume base pressure in the gas flow equations.

base_temperature_c.description: Base temperature for standard volume: the Weymouth base temperature (default 520 °R, about 60 °F).
base_temperature_c.title: Base Temperature C
base_temperature_c.x-impact: Standard-volume base temperature in the gas flow equations.

calorific_mj_per_m3.description: Higher heating value used for energy conversion (therm/kWh display and billing).
calorific_mj_per_m3.title: Calorific Mj Per M3
calorific_mj_per_m3.x-impact: Energy per cubic metre for showing gas in GJ or therms. Bills charge per m³, so no amount changes.

coincidence_floor.description: Gas coincidence factor floor a in CF(n) = a + (1-a)/√n.
coincidence_floor.title: Coincidence Floor
coincidence_floor.x-impact: How much gas peaks overlap: larger floors size bigger gas mains.

design_m3h_base.description: Design-hour demand per house, base component (≈ 40 CFH).
design_m3h_base.title: Design M3H Base
design_m3h_base.x-impact: Design-hour demand per house: gas main sizes. Usage is not affected.

design_m3h_per_m2.description: Design-hour demand per m² of floor area (≈ 0.6 CFH/m²).
design_m3h_per_m2.title: Design M3H Per M2
design_m3h_per_m2.x-impact: Design-hour demand per floor area: gas main sizes.

lp_core_before_year.description: Districts built before this year are on the low-pressure system.
lp_core_before_year.title: Lp Core Before Year
lp_core_before_year.x-impact: Districts older than this sit on the low-pressure core.

lp_kpa.description: Low-pressure legacy main set point (7 in w.c.).
lp_kpa.title: Lp Kpa
lp_kpa.x-impact: Low-pressure core set point: gas pressures on the operations day.

min_main_mm.title: Min Main Mm
min_main_mm.x-impact: Smallest gas main: pipe sizes and pressures on the map. Usage is not affected.

mp_kpa.title: Mp Kpa
mp_kpa.x-impact: Medium-pressure set point: gas pressures on the operations day.

scheme.description: Medium-pressure PE everywhere with a regulator at every meter, optionally with a legacy low-pressure core fed by district regulators.
scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.x-impact: Medium pressure everywhere or a legacy low-pressure core: regulators and pressures on the map.

transmission_kpa.description: Off-map transmission pressure at the city gate inlet.
transmission_kpa.title: Transmission Kpa
transmission_kpa.x-impact: Pressure into the city gate: gas pressures on the operations day.

valve_spacing_m.description: Maximum spacing of main valves on feeders.
valve_spacing_m.title: Valve Spacing M
valve_spacing_m.x-impact: Valve spacing: how much main a leak repair isolates.

GasConfig.title: Natural gas

HousingConfig.description: Lots, buildings and the people and appliances inside them.

ac_rate.description: Share of houses with central air conditioning.
ac_rate.title: Ac Rate
ac_rate.x-impact: Central air adds cooling load on hot days: higher July and August electric usage and bills, and summer high-bill checks.

electric_heat_rate.description: Share of houses heated electrically (baseboard or heat pump) where gas is available. All houses in all-electric districts are electric.
electric_heat_rate.x-impact: Electric instead of gas heat: winter electric usage and bills rise, gas accounts and gas usage fall.

ev_rate.description: Share of houses with an EV charger.
ev_rate.x-impact: EV chargers add about 6.5 kWh a day per home, all year: higher electric usage and bills, and bigger transformers on the map.

heat_pump_share_of_electric.description: Share of electric heating that is a heat pump (vs baseboard).
heat_pump_share_of_electric.title: Heat Pump Share Of Electric
heat_pump_share_of_electric.x-impact: Heat pumps use far less than baseboard heat for the same warmth: lower winter electric usage and bills.

household_size_weights.description: Relative frequency of households with 1..6 occupants.
household_size_weights.title: Household Size Weights
household_size_weights.x-impact: Bigger households use more water (people times litres per day) and more base electricity: higher water bills above all.

irrigation_rate.description: Share of houses that irrigate lawns in summer.
irrigation_rate.title: Irrigation Rate
irrigation_rate.x-impact: Lawn watering adds summer water use (May to September, peaking in July): higher summer water bills and seasonal swings VEE must accept.

lot_depth_m.x-impact: Deeper lots are larger (pools need over 600 m²) and leave room for deeper houses on shallow streets. On synthetic towns it also reshapes blocks, which re-draws households, so totals move by about seed-sized noise.

lot_frontage_m.x-impact: Wider lots build wider houses (55 to 70 percent of the frontage, up to 15 m): more floor area, so more heating and base load. Fewer lots fit each street, so homes spread to other streets and eras. Pools need lots over 600 m².

occupancy_rate.description: Share of premises occupied at simulation start.
occupancy_rate.title: Occupancy Rate
occupancy_rate.x-impact: Vacant homes use almost nothing (12 percent of base load, 3 percent of water). Fewer occupied homes: lower usage, more zero-use reads for VEE, vacant-consuming cases and first bills at move-in.

pool_rate.description: Share of houses (on lots > 600 m²) with a pool.
pool_rate.title: Pool Rate
pool_rate.x-impact: Pools (only on lots over 600 m², more in modern districts) run a pump and heater on electricity, about 7.5 kWh a day from May to September, and top up 0.15 m³ of water a day. Pools are not heated with gas in this engine.

pv_kw_max.title: Pv Kw Max
pv_kw_max.x-impact: Largest PV system: more export and larger summer credits per solar home.

pv_kw_min.title: Pv Kw Min
pv_kw_min.x-impact: Smallest PV system: more export and larger net-metering credits per solar home.

rental_share.description: Share of premises that are rentals (more contract turnover).
rental_share.title: Rental Share
rental_share.x-impact: Rentals turn over: more move-ins and move-outs, so more first bills, final bills, short tenancies and contract changes for billing and collections.

setback_m.x-impact: How far houses sit back from the street. On shallow lots a deep setback makes the house shallower, a fraction of a percent of usage.

solar_rate.description: Share of houses with rooftop PV by era.
solar_rate.x-impact: Homes with rooftop PV by era: export registers, net-metering credits on bills, and low or negative summer net use that VEE and billing must handle.

two_storey_share.description: Share of two-storey houses by era.
two_storey_share.x-impact: Two storeys double the floor area on the same footprint: more heating in winter, more cooling and base load, and higher bills.

HousingConfig.title: Housing & households

IncidentConfig.description: What goes wrong, how often. Rates are per year. Each operations day draws its background incidents at these rates; they are the defaults of the operations run's random-incident settings (x-run-setting), so a run can change them without a new town.

collector_outages_per_year.title: Collector Outages Per Year
collector_outages_per_year.x-impact: AMI collector outages: the meters behind it miss their nightly read that day. Customers do not notice them.

gas_main_leaks_per_100km.description: Leaks per 100 km of gas main per year.
gas_main_leaks_per_100km.title: Gas Main Leaks Per 100Km
gas_main_leaks_per_100km.x-impact: Random gas main leaks on the operations day and across the year: crew calls, isolations and gas odour calls from the neighbours.

gas_service_leaks_per_1000.description: Leaks per 1,000 gas services per year.
gas_service_leaks_per_1000.title: Gas Service Leaks Per 1000
gas_service_leaks_per_1000.x-impact: Random service leaks on the operations day and across the year: gas odour calls and a household without gas until the repair.

manual_only.description: Disable random hazards; only manually injected incidents occur (the run's "Random incidents" switch defaults to the opposite).
manual_only.title: Manual Only
manual_only.x-impact: Turns random incidents off on the operations day; only the ones you inject happen. The year draws them unless Outages & leaks is off.

overhead_faults_per_km_storm_day.description: Overhead primary faults per km per storm day.
overhead_faults_per_km_storm_day.title: Overhead Faults Per Km Storm Day
overhead_faults_per_km_storm_day.x-impact: Storm faults on overhead lines: feeder outages on storm days, on the operations day and across the year, and the outage reports.

transformer_failures_per_1000.description: Transformer failures per 1,000 units per year (×3 when overloaded).
transformer_failures_per_1000.title: Transformer Failures Per 1000
transformer_failures_per_1000.x-impact: Transformer failures (three times as many where units are overloaded): small outages on the operations day and across the year.

water_main_breaks_per_100km.description: Main breaks per 100 km per year (×2 for cast iron).
water_main_breaks_per_100km.title: Water Main Breaks Per 100Km
water_main_breaks_per_100km.x-impact: Random main breaks on the operations day and across the year: customers without water and the outage reports they make.

IncidentConfig.title: Incidents & hazards

OperationsConfig.description: Fleet, shifts, response targets and vehicle movement. Crews, readers, the shift and the gas target are the defaults of the operations run settings (x-run-setting), so a run can change them without a new town.

electric_crews.title: Electric Crews
electric_crews.x-impact: Electric crews: how long outages last on the operations day.

gas_crews.title: Gas Crews
gas_crews.x-impact: Gas crews: how fast leaks are made safe on the operations day.

gas_response_target_min.description: Target response to a gas odour call.
gas_response_target_min.title: Gas Response Target Min
gas_response_target_min.x-impact: The response target gas crews are measured against on the operations day.

meter_techs.title: Meter Techs
meter_techs.x-impact: Meter technicians for exchanges and investigations on the operations day. The year's field capacity is Field orders per day.

meter_vans.title: Meter Vans
meter_vans.x-impact: AMR vans driving routes on the operations day; routes are shared among them.

meter_walkers.title: Meter Walkers
meter_walkers.x-impact: Walkers reading manual routes on the operations day.

shift_end_hour.title: Shift End Hour
shift_end_hour.x-impact: When the day shift ends: non-emergency repairs left after it wait for the next morning.

shift_start_hour.description: Day shift start. Non-emergency work (AMI collector repairs) waits for the day shift; emergencies are worked around the clock.
shift_start_hour.title: Shift Start Hour
shift_start_hour.x-impact: When the day shift starts: non-emergency repairs wait for it.

speed_kmh_arterial.title: Speed Kmh Arterial
speed_kmh_arterial.x-impact: Driving speed on arterials: crew and van travel times.

speed_kmh_collector.title: Speed Kmh Collector
speed_kmh_collector.x-impact: Driving speed on collector roads: crew and van travel times on the operations day.

speed_kmh_local.title: Speed Kmh Local
speed_kmh_local.x-impact: Driving speed on local streets: crew and van travel times on the operations day.

water_crews.title: Water Crews
water_crews.x-impact: Water crews: how long main breaks keep customers off.

OperationsConfig.title: Field operations

OutagesConfig.description: The operations day's background incidents drawn for every day of the year (same storms and leaks the map shows on a date): who loses power or water, for how long, and where gas is smelled. The contact centre hears about them.

enabled.description: Draw outages and leaks across the year.
enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.x-impact: Draw the operations day's incidents for every day of the year: customers out lose their use and AMI meters go dark. Off: no outages, and outage and gas odour contacts are background only.

incident_factor.description: Multiplies every incident rate (leaks, breaks, failures, faults).
incident_factor.title: Incident Factor
incident_factor.x-impact: Multiplies every incident rate: more outages, main breaks and gas leaks, the use they cut and the contacts they bring.

restore_factor.description: Multiplies the time to restore service.
restore_factor.title: Restore Factor
restore_factor.x-impact: Multiplies the time to restore service: more use lost, more AMI reads falling inside an outage, and twice the outage reports past two hours.

storm_factor.description: Multiplies the chance that a day is a storm day.
storm_factor.title: Storm Factor
storm_factor.x-impact: Multiplies the chance of a storm day: more overhead line faults, outages (use lost, a read missed when one falls inside) and outage reports, mostly May to September.

OutagesConfig.title: Outages & leaks over the year

ProcessConfig.description: Work queues, automation, workforce, costs and carrying cost.

analyst_accuracy.description: Share of reviews where the analyst finds the true cause.
analyst_accuracy.title: Analyst Accuracy
analyst_accuracy.x-impact: Reviews where the analyst finds the true cause. Lower: wrong dispositions, billing errors that surface later as rebills and complaints.

analyst_hours_per_day.description: Productive queue hours per analyst per business day.
analyst_hours_per_day.title: Analyst Hours Per Day
analyst_hours_per_day.x-impact: Queue hours per analyst per day: capacity, like the number of analysts.

analyst_queue_days_max.title: Analyst Queue Days Max
analyst_queue_days_max.x-impact: Longest first-look wait: the tail of slow cases, open-case counts and carry.

analyst_queue_days_min.description: Minimum queue wait before an analyst picks up an exception.
analyst_queue_days_min.title: Analyst Queue Days Min
analyst_queue_days_min.x-impact: Shortest wait before an analyst first looks at a case: every human case takes at least this long, so carry and days to release rise.

analysts.description: Billing analysts working the exception queues.
analysts.title: Analysts
analysts.x-impact: People working the queues. Fewer: backlog grows, cases age, estimates and blocked bills wait longer and carry builds; more: queues clear faster.

carry_rate_per_day.description: Carrying cost per account per day before invoicing.
carry_rate_per_day.title: Carry Rate Per Day
carry_rate_per_day.x-impact: Cost of a day a bill is held back. Prices the carry; it does not change which cases happen.

field_days_min.description: Earliest a field order is worked after it is raised.
field_days_min.title: Field Days Min
field_days_min.x-impact: Earliest a field order is worked after it is raised.

field_orders_per_day.description: Meter investigations, re-reads and exchanges completed per business day.
field_orders_per_day.title: Field Orders Per Day
field_orders_per_day.x-impact: Field orders worked per day (re-reads, checks, exchanges). Fewer: field backlog, longer estimate streaks, stuck and slow meters fixed later.

receivable_carry_ratio.description: Receivable carry as a share of the billing carry rate.
receivable_carry_ratio.title: Receivable Carry Ratio
receivable_carry_ratio.x-impact: Carry on unpaid invoices as a share of the billing carry rate. Prices receivable carry only.

review_minutes_max.title: Review Minutes Max
review_minutes_max.x-impact: Longest review: capacity and labor cost per case.

review_minutes_min.title: Review Minutes Min
review_minutes_min.x-impact: Shortest review: longer reviews cut how many cases a day each analyst clears.

rpa_coverage.description: Share of exception types with an RPA/auto-resolve rule.
rpa_coverage.title: Rpa Coverage
rpa_coverage.x-impact: Share of exception types automation resolves. More coverage: fewer cases for analysts, cheaper and faster resolution, less carry; uncovered types still queue for people.

supervisor_hours_per_day.description: Supervisor hours on escalations per business day.
supervisor_hours_per_day.title: Supervisor Hours Per Day
supervisor_hours_per_day.x-impact: Supervisor time for escalations: how fast the Escalations queue clears.

supervisor_minutes.title: Supervisor Minutes
supervisor_minutes.x-impact: Supervisor time per escalation: capacity and labor cost.

supervisor_queue_days_max.description: Maximum wait before a supervisor picks up an escalation from an analyst or you. An escalation you take yourself (assign) waits for you.
supervisor_queue_days_max.title: Supervisor Queue Days Max
supervisor_queue_days_max.x-impact: Longest wait before a supervisor picks up an escalation: the tail of held high-impact bills.

supervisor_queue_days_min.description: Minimum wait before a supervisor picks up an escalation (VEE's own escalations wait this long).
supervisor_queue_days_min.title: Supervisor Queue Days Min
supervisor_queue_days_min.x-impact: Shortest wait for a supervisor: escalated cases take at least this long.

supervisors.title: Supervisors
supervisors.x-impact: Supervisors approving escalations. Zero: escalated cases wait, high-impact bills stay held.

ProcessConfig.title: Meter-to-cash process

ReadingConfig.description: How periodic billing reads succeed or fail, by meter technology.

ami_missed_read.description: AMI billing reads still missing after the head-end retry window.
ami_missed_read.title: Ami Missed Read
ami_missed_read.x-impact: AMI reads still missing after retries: estimates, missing-read cases and estimate streaks.

amr_missed_read.description: Drive-by reads missed (no signal, street skipped).
amr_missed_read.title: Amr Missed Read
amr_missed_read.x-impact: Drive-by reads missed: estimates and missing-read cases on AMR routes.

manual_no_access.description: Manual reads with no access (locked gate, dog, meter inside).
manual_no_access.title: Manual No Access
manual_no_access.x-impact: Walked reads with no access: estimates, streaks and field reads.

no_access_repeat.description: Chance a missed manual read is missed again the next month.
no_access_repeat.title: No Access Repeat
no_access_repeat.x-impact: Chance a no-access meter is missed again next month: longer estimate streaks and more field reads.

read_cost_ami.title: Read Cost Ami
read_cost_ami.x-impact: Cost of one AMI read. Prices reading; no read changes.

read_cost_amr.title: Read Cost Amr
read_cost_amr.x-impact: Cost of one drive-by read. Prices reading in the cost totals; no read changes.

read_cost_manual.title: Read Cost Manual
read_cost_manual.x-impact: Cost of one walked read. Prices reading in the cost totals; no read changes.

ReadingConfig.title: Meter reading

ScenarioConfig.description: Demonstration scenario on the live clock.

date.title: Date
date.x-impact: The day the map shows and the Studio opens on. The year's results are the same; only the default view date moves.

hour.title: Hour
hour.x-impact: The hour the map's live clock starts at. The year is unchanged.

leak_m3h.description: Leak rate added to the target premise's water demand.
leak_m3h.title: Leak M3H
leak_m3h.x-impact: Leak size in the map's leak demonstration: flows and pressures that day.

name.title: Name
name.x-impact: The map's demonstration (normal, solar noon, leak, substation outage) on the live day. The year is unchanged.

target_premise.description: Premise targeted by the leak scenario (default: first premise).
target_premise.title: Target Premise
target_premise.x-impact: The premise the map's leak demonstration targets.

ScenarioConfig.title: Scenario

SeedsConfig.description: Master seed and optional per-subsystem re-rolls.

anomalies.description: Override seed for the meter-to-cash run (missed reads, anomalies, analyst work, bill checks); a request's run seed overrides it per run.
anomalies.title: Anomalies
anomalies.x-impact: Re-rolls the year's draws (missed reads, anomalies, analyst work, bill checks) on the same households. A run's own seed overrides it without building a new town.

households.description: Override seed for household attributes (occupants, solar, EV, heating).
households.title: Households
households.x-impact: Re-rolls who lives where: occupants, solar, EVs, heating fuel, pools, payer profiles and tenancies. Streets stay put. Small towns move several percent on solar export.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.x-impact: Re-rolls the random leaks, breaks, faults and collector outages, on the operations day and across the year, so the outage and gas odour contacts move too.

master.description: Master seed. Any text or integer; same seed + config + generator version reproduces the same town byte for byte.
master.title: Master
master.x-impact: Re-rolls everything: the streets, households, weather, incidents and the year's draws. Use it to see how much results vary by chance alone.

town.description: Override seed for geography only (roads growth, parcels, buildings).
town.title: Town
town.x-impact: Re-rolls the geography (growth, lots, buildings). Households sit on lots, so they are drawn again too and usage totals shift by a few percent.

weather.description: Override seed for weather series (re-roll storms, keep the town).
weather.title: Weather
weather.x-impact: Re-rolls the daily temperatures: heating and cooling usage follow, and so do the cold days that make AMI, AMR and walked reads miss more often.

SeedsConfig.title: Seeds

TownConfig.description: Size, street grid, terrain and land use. Towns are generic: every street comes from these settings and the seed.

anchor_lat.description: Latitude of the town (sun path, day length).
anchor_lat.title: Anchor Lat
anchor_lat.x-impact: Where the town sits on the globe: its latitude and the sun path in the map's day and night. Measured: no usage, network or year change.

anchor_lon.title: Anchor Lon
anchor_lon.x-impact: Where the town sits on the globe (its longitude). Measured: no usage, network or year change.

arterial_spacing_m.description: Mean spacing of arterial roads (concession-grid style).
arterial_spacing_m.title: Arterial Spacing M
arterial_spacing_m.x-impact: Synthetic towns and grown districts only: how far apart the main roads run, so block sizes and drive times. On a real-street town it does nothing.

arterial_warp_m.description: Amplitude of the smooth warp applied to arterials.
arterial_warp_m.title: Arterial Warp M
arterial_warp_m.x-impact: Synthetic towns and grown districts only: how much the main roads bend.

collector_block_m.description: Superblocks larger than this get a collector road.
collector_block_m.title: Collector Block M
collector_block_m.x-impact: Synthetic towns and grown districts only: superblocks larger than this get a collector road.

commercial_cluster_m.description: Distance over which commercial frontage clusters around main-road intersections and downtown. Smaller gives tight corner clusters, larger gives long strips.
commercial_cluster_m.title: Commercial Cluster M
x-effects: where storefronts sit along main roads
commercial_cluster_m.x-impact: How tightly shops cluster around main-road junctions and downtown. Which lots hold shops changes, not how many.

commercial_share_arterial.description: Share of developed lots fronting an arterial (beyond the downtown main street) that become commercial or mixed-use premises. The rest are homes, or rear yards where modern subdivisions back onto the arterial.
commercial_share_arterial.title: Commercial Share Arterial
commercial_share_arterial.x-impact: Share of arterial frontage that becomes shops: more commercial accounts (large, steady electric and gas loads) while homes stay at the count.

commercial_share_collector.description: Share of developed lots fronting a collector that become commercial or mixed-use premises.
commercial_share_collector.title: Commercial Share Collector
commercial_share_collector.x-impact: Share of collector frontage that becomes shops: more commercial accounts.

commercial_share_local.description: Share of developed lots on local streets that become commercial (corner stores near downtown and where local streets meet main roads).
commercial_share_local.title: Commercial Share Local
commercial_share_local.x-impact: Corner stores on local streets: a few more commercial accounts.

commercial_strip_m.description: Length of the downtown main street: arterial frontage within half this distance of the centre is all commercial (up to 80 lots). The frontage shares below apply beyond it.
commercial_strip_m.title: Commercial Strip M
commercial_strip_m.x-impact: Length of the all-commercial main street downtown: more storefront accounts with commercial usage, tariffs and gas heat.

corridor_max_deflection_deg.description: Arterial/collector road edges continue one corridor through a junction when the heading changes by at most this much.
corridor_max_deflection_deg.title: Corridor Max Deflection Deg
corridor_max_deflection_deg.x-impact: How sharp a bend still counts as one road corridor: feeder routes follow corridors, so it can change which customers share a feeder (and an outage) on the operations day.

corridor_name_bonus_deg.description: Extra deflection allowed when both edges carry the same street name (a name is weak evidence of continuity).
corridor_name_bonus_deg.title: Corridor Name Bonus Deg
corridor_name_bonus_deg.x-impact: Extra bend allowed when both roads share a name, for feeder corridors on the operations day.

era_core_year.description: Construction year at the town centre.
era_core_year.title: Era Core Year
