era_core_year.x-impact: When the centre was built; ages every home. Older homes leak more heat (more gas or electric heating), rent more, have less solar and EV, and sit on overhead lines and cast-iron mains.

era_noise_years.description: Std-dev of era noise per district.
era_noise_years.title: Era Noise Years
era_noise_years.x-impact: Scatter of construction years between districts: a few districts change era, which shifts their insulation, appliances and tenure.

era_span_years.description: Years added from centre to edge (era = core + span·(d/R)^1.2 + noise).
era_span_years.title: Era Span Years
era_span_years.x-impact: How much newer the edge is than the centre. A wider span puts more homes in the modern era: better insulation, more solar, EVs, pools and irrigation.

houses.description: Number of residential premises to place.
houses.title: Houses
houses.x-impact: The number of homes. Accounts, reads, exceptions, bills and staffing load scale with it; a bigger town also spreads further, so its edge reaches newer eras.

houses_per_school.description: One school per this many houses.
houses_per_school.title: Houses Per School
houses_per_school.x-impact: One school per this many homes, rounded (towns under about 1,250 homes have none). A school is an institutional account with a large floor area, heavy water use and gas heat.

industrial_lots.title: Industrial Lots
industrial_lots.x-impact: Large industrial customers. Each is a very large electric, gas and water account; two of them are about a tenth of a small town's usage.

margin_m.description: Empty margin around the developed area.
margin_m.title: Margin M
margin_m.x-impact: Empty land around the developed area, where utility sites sit. It moves things on the map only.

park_share.description: Share of blocks kept as parks.
park_share.title: Park Share
park_share.x-impact: Blocks kept as parks. Homes move to other blocks; the count stays the same.

terrain_relief_m.title: Terrain Relief M
terrain_relief_m.x-impact: Hillier towns get a second water pressure zone, another elevated tank and PRVs or boosters at zone boundaries: pressures on the operations day.

terrain_wavelength_m.title: Terrain Wavelength M
terrain_wavelength_m.x-impact: How quickly the ground rises and falls: elevations, water pressures and zone boundaries on the operations day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the town (read schedules, billing calendar, day/night).
timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.x-impact: The local clock for timestamps, read schedules and business days. Measured: the year's figures do not change, only the times printed on records.

units.description: Display unit profile (stored values are always SI).
units.title: Units
units.x-impact: How values are labelled (Ontario, US or UK units). Stored values stay SI; no result changes.

TownConfig.title: Town & geography

VeeConfig.description: Validation, estimation and editing: the five-test battery, confidence and disposition (VEE v5 shape).

accept_confidence.description: Auto-accept at or above this confidence.
accept_confidence.title: Accept Confidence
accept_confidence.x-impact: Auto-accept at or above this confidence. Higher: fewer reads auto-accepted, more for review.

escalate_impact.description: Escalate a doubtful read when its bill impact exceeds this.
escalate_impact.title: Escalate Impact
escalate_impact.x-impact: Doubtful reads whose bill impact exceeds this go to a supervisor: lower means more escalations and supervisor load.

estimation.description: Estimation method for missing or rejected reads.
estimation.title: Estimation
estimation.x-impact: How missing or rejected reads are estimated: prior year or average daily use. Changes estimated amounts and later true-ups.

high_ratio.description: Flag consumption above this multiple of expected (tolerance high).
high_ratio.title: High Ratio
high_ratio.x-impact: Flag use above this multiple of expected. Lower: more high reads flagged (more cases, more real spikes caught, more false alarms).

history_noise.description: Spread of prior-year history around this year's normal usage.
history_noise.title: History Noise
history_noise.x-impact: How far last year's history strays from this year's normal use: more noise, more reads look odd against history.

low_ratio.description: Flag consumption below this share of expected (tolerance low).
low_ratio.title: Low Ratio
low_ratio.x-impact: Flag use below this share of expected. Higher: more low reads flagged, catching slow and stuck meters sooner at the cost of more cases.

max_consecutive_estimates.description: Estimates in a row before a field read is ordered.
max_consecutive_estimates.title: Max Consecutive Estimates
max_consecutive_estimates.x-impact: Estimates in a row before a field read is ordered: lower means more field orders, shorter streaks.

max_period_days.title: Max Period Days
max_period_days.x-impact: Longest plausible read period: longer periods fail the timing test and go to review.

min_period_days.title: Min Period Days
min_period_days.x-impact: Shortest plausible read period: shorter periods fail the timing test.

oms_events.description: Use outage events (OMS, AMI last gasps) from operations: hours without service lower the expected use.
oms_events.title: Oms Events
oms_events.x-impact: Use outage events: hours without service lower the expected use, so outage-explained low reads are accepted instead of flagged. Only matters when a run carries interruptions from an operations day.

reject_confidence.title: Reject Confidence
reject_confidence.x-impact: Reject below this confidence (the read is replaced by an estimate).

trend_periods.description: … for this many periods in a row.
trend_periods.title: Trend Periods
trend_periods.x-impact: Periods of low use before the trend flag: fewer means earlier detection, more cases.

trend_ratio.description: Persistent low use: flag reads below this share of expected …
trend_ratio.title: Trend Ratio
trend_ratio.x-impact: Persistent low use below this share of expected is flagged: how slow meters and tamper are caught.

zero_at_occupied.description: Flag zero consumption at an occupied premise.
zero_at_occupied.title: Zero At Occupied
zero_at_occupied.x-impact: Flag zero use at an occupied home: catches stuck meters and failed exchanges.

VeeConfig.title: VEE rules

WaterConfig.description: Supply, pumping, storage, mains, hydrants and services.

arterial_main_mm.description: Minimum transmission main on arterials leaving the pump station.
arterial_main_mm.title: Arterial Main Mm
arterial_main_mm.x-impact: Smallest transmission main from the pump station.

cast_iron_before_year.description: Mains along streets built before this year are unlined cast iron (the concrete trunk excepted).
cast_iron_before_year.title: Cast Iron Before Year
cast_iron_before_year.x-impact: Mains older than this are cast iron: rougher and break twice as often on the operations day.

collector_main_mm.title: Collector Main Mm
collector_main_mm.x-impact: Smallest main on collector roads: pipe sizes and pressures on the map.

fire_flow_commercial_lps.title: Fire Flow Commercial Lps
fire_flow_commercial_lps.x-impact: Fire flow that sizes commercial mains: pipe sizes and pressures on the map.

fire_flow_industrial_lps.title: Fire Flow Industrial Lps
fire_flow_industrial_lps.x-impact: Fire flow that sizes the industrial and supply mains.

fire_flow_residential_lps.title: Fire Flow Residential Lps
fire_flow_residential_lps.x-impact: Fire flow that sizes residential mains: bigger mains, lower velocities.

hw_c_new.description: Hazen-Williams C for PVC/ductile iron mains.
hw_c_new.title: Hw C New
hw_c_new.x-impact: Pipe roughness of new mains: pressures on the operations day.

hw_c_old.description: Hazen-Williams C for unlined cast iron mains.
hw_c_old.title: Hw C Old
hw_c_old.x-impact: Pipe roughness of old cast iron: more head loss, lower pressures.

hydrant_spacing_commercial_m.title: Hydrant Spacing Commercial M
hydrant_spacing_commercial_m.x-impact: Hydrant spacing in commercial areas: hydrant count on the map.

hydrant_spacing_m.title: Hydrant Spacing M
hydrant_spacing_m.x-impact: Hydrant spacing on residential mains: hydrant count on the map.

irrigation_m3_per_day.title: Irrigation M3 Per Day
irrigation_m3_per_day.x-impact: Summer watering per irrigating home: higher summer water usage and bills.

lpcd.description: Indoor residential use per person per day.
lpcd.title: Lpcd
lpcd.x-impact: Indoor water per person per day: every home's water usage and bill scales with it, and wastewater charges follow.

max_day_factor.title: Max Day Factor
max_day_factor.x-impact: Max-day demand used to size mains and storage on the map.

min_main_mm.description: Smallest main where hydrants are attached.
min_main_mm.title: Min Main Mm
min_main_mm.x-impact: Smallest main that carries hydrants: pipe sizes and pressures on the map.

peak_hour_factor.title: Peak Hour Factor
peak_hour_factor.x-impact: Peak-hour demand used to size mains: pipe sizes and pressures on the map.

pump_units.description: Pumps at the booster station (one is standby).
pump_units.title: Pump Units
pump_units.x-impact: Pumps at the station, one on standby: pumping capacity on the operations day.

tank_overflow_above_ground_m.description: Elevated tank overflow height above the highest service in its zone.
tank_overflow_above_ground_m.title: Tank Overflow Above Ground M
tank_overflow_above_ground_m.x-impact: Elevated tank height: static pressure in its zone.

valve_spacing_m.title: Valve Spacing M
valve_spacing_m.x-impact: Valve spacing: how many customers a main break isolates.

zone_band_m.title: Zone Band M
